response.sql:
WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS trader_count
  FROM transactionrecord AS tx
  JOIN trader AS tr
    ON tx.trdref = tr.tradereg
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
), stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(trader_count) AS avg_count,
         SUM(trader_count) AS total_count
  FROM per_type
)
SELECT p.tradekind,
       p.trader_count,
       1.0 * p.trader_count / s.total_count AS share_of_total,
       p.trader_count - s.avg_count AS above_average_by
FROM per_type AS p
CROSS JOIN stats AS s
WHERE s.avg_count IS NOT NULL
  AND p.trader_count > s.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: “How big is each trader type” counts matched transaction records, so a trader with multiple records contributes once per record; NULL trader types form one group.
